description: Explicit controller assumptions; not measured modem parameters.
notes: The current simulation accounts for modem setup and transmission energy but does not model modem idle-tail power.
Idle power is zero by default to preserve the existing model boundary; nonzero values require external measurement or explicit sensitivity assumptions.
The expected number of packets in an arrival burst is estimated from the observed Poisson inter-arrival EWMA and the modem tail timer using exp(lambda * T).
The maximum expected packet count caps the analytical forecast and is configurable.
